answer: Charge each attestation a geographic toll: vote weight counts only distinct regions it touches, and each region's toll burns when exceeded. Clones cluster in cheap delta infrastructure, so a farm's quorum saturates one harbor's quota instantly, while honest agents spreading across many harbors never hit any cap. Forcing attestation writers to hold quill-signed proof-of-work from every claimed region means a botnet farming one cheap zone pays the full toll for regions it never touches, making bulk cloning unaffordable.
